name: injected_revision_harness
description: Build deterministic nested synthetic revision batches without executing or timing a treatment.

base_state.meaning: latest-vintage state shared by all treatment inputs

selection.algorithm: sort by sha256(seed + unit-separator + cell_id), then cell_id; take the first selection_count cells

mutation.rule: add one published decimal unit; subtract it only when a percentage would exceed 100

synthetic_provenance.revised_source_id: inherit the official source_id associated with the base vintage
synthetic_provenance.b2_score_policy: look up the frozen score of revised_source_id; never score synthetic_source_id
synthetic_provenance.identifier_algorithm: first 20 hex characters of sha256 over the frozen scenario and cell payload

routing.canonical_payload: one shared injected-revisions file filtered by scenario_id

invariants: scenario cell sets are deterministic nested prefixes
every selected value changes by exactly one published unit
synthetic records are explicitly distinguished from official BPS records
B0, B1, B2, and B3 receive the same canonical payload checksum for a scenario
H8 produces no runtime or physical-storage result
the validation profile is not mislabeled as the final experiment freeze
